question: Where are a golf course within a distance of 120 kilometers to the south of South 6th St. Community Garden, Philadelphia, PA?
sql: SELECT park_name FROM parks WHERE leisure = 'golf_course' AND ST_DWithin( geometry::geography, ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%South 6th St. Community Garden%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Philadelphia%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%PA%' LIMIT 1 )::geography, 120000 ) AND degrees( ST_Azimuth( ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%South 6th St. Community Garden%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Philadelphia%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%PA%' LIMIT 1 ), ST_Centroid(geometry) ) ) BETWEEN 157.5 AND 202.5;
